body_lead: Rajasthan Chief Secretary V Srinivas has directed officials to use Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics and emerging technology for the technical strengthening of DigiVan Portal, which is country's first Digital Public Infrastructure in Forest sector. Developed in collaboration by the Rajasthan Forest Department, JICA's DXLab and BCG, DigiVan represents a transformative step towards digital-first, data-driven forestry management. Srinivas said that the Digivan portal is an important initiative towards digital transformation of the Forest Department.
